credit.credit-words: There’s a Wideness in God’s Mercy
WORDS: Frederick W. Faber, 1862. MUSIC: “Wellesley”; Lizzie S. Tourjee, 1877. Public Domain.

Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever. Psa. 106:1 God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us... hath quickened us together with Christ. Eph. 2:4-5
